name: v11-live

accept-v10-render.reason: the bench has no SITE: it runs apps/api/server.py on a temporary DATA_DIR with a test admin password hash, serves the NEW, BASE and PRE dists locally with /api going to it, logs into that admin (R3, the Drawing tab) and publishes to it; every R has a BASE or PRE control
accept-v10-render.coveredByStandIn: only the sorted-by-default fact of R1, in part: V8 "nothing asked" drawn sorted and no accumulating renderer made, on two live scenes. Not covered: device class, presets, per-scene and pilot precedence through the admin, REC, share picture

failures.check: drawn sorted, no accumulating renderer made, and hook.drawing.from.stochastic === "device"
failures.verdict: bench assertion that cannot run unchanged on live; NOT a live defect, not flakiness (same result twice)
failures.why: the live catalogue (GET /api/catalog) carries the owner's per-scene render entry {stochastic: false} on 39e63ce9, so the one who decides is 'scene' (sorted). The local bench serves a build with no catalogue, where the source is 'device'. On 70b50d42, which has no render entry, the same check reads 'device' and passes. The claim that matters (nothing asked is drawn sorted, no accumulating renderer is made) holds on both scenes.
